generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted
All other terms and condition are as per KW-1 tender document and General Conditions Separate Sheet uploaded

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Workdone Certifiate Satisfactorily completed as a prime contractor, at least one similar nature of work such as Building work of value not less than Rs.5.89 lakhs in any one year.-usually not less than 50 Percentage of the estimated value of contract-2021-22 to 2025-26.

To qualify for award of the Contract, each bidder should have attained in the last five years i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26 a.achieved in at least two financial years a minimum financial turnover-Turnover certificate with Profit and loss statements and IT returns-in all classes of civil engineering construction works only Rs.11.78 Lakhs

Tenderer must have liquid assets and /or availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs.3.53 Lakhs Credit lines/ letter of credit/certificates from banks for meeting the fund requirement etc. issued the Nationalised bank should be furnished by the contractor And LOC issued by such a bank should be of unconditional-LOC as per KW-1 bid document.
Ongoing work details most attached with self attested if falls information submitted tender will be rejected
